sample_detailed_cases.question: What is the monthly revenue trend in 2017?
sample_detailed_cases.pre_sql: SELECT strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year_month, SUM(order_items.price) AS monthly_revenue FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp), strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY year_month;

sample_detailed_cases.question: What is the monthly revenue trend for customers in state SP in 2017?

sample_detailed_cases.question: What is the quarterly revenue breakdown for 2018?
sample_detailed_cases.pre_sql:
SELECT
    strftime('%Y', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year,
    CASE
        WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 1
        WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 2
        WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END AS quarter,
    SUM(order_items.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items
JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018'
GROUP BY
    strftime('%Y', orders.order_purchase_timestamp),
    CASE
        WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 1
        WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 2
        WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN 3
        ELSE 4
    END;
sample_detailed_cases.post_sql:
SELECT
            p.product_category_name,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
            ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_revenue
        FROM order_items oi
        JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
        JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
        GROUP BY p.product_category_name
        ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
        LIMIT 10

sample_detailed_cases.question: What is the distribution of total revenue and order count across days of the week?
sample_detailed_cases.pre_sql: SELECT strftime('%w', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS day_of_week, SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY strftime('%w', o.order_purchase_timestamp) ORDER BY day_of_week;
sample_detailed_cases.post_sql: SELECT strftime('%w', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS day_of_week, SUM(order_items.price) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS order_count FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id GROUP BY day_of_week ORDER BY day_of_week;

sample_detailed_cases.question: What are the top 3 months by total sales revenue?

sample_detailed_cases.post_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, SUM(order_items.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3;

sample_detailed_cases.question: What are the top 3 highest revenue days in 2017?
sample_detailed_cases.pre_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) AS day, SUM(order_items.price) AS total_revenue FROM order_items JOIN orders ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', orders.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY day ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3;

  strftime('%Y-%m-%d', shipping_limit_date) AS day,
  SUM(price) AS total_revenue
FROM order_items
WHERE strftime('%Y', shipping_limit_date) = '2017'
  AND strftime('%Y', order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017'
GROUP BY day
